questions.scenario: You meet a new person at a social gathering. What is the very first thing you naturally notice about them?

options.text: The shape of their hands, their fingers, and how they use their hands when speaking.
The specific shape of their eyes, jawline, and the subtle lines on their forehead.
Their posture, how they walk into the room, and whether their arms are crossed or open.
The invisible 'vibe' or energy they bring into the room, before they even say a word.

questions.scenario: You suspect a friend is hiding a secret from you. How do you try to figure out the truth?

options.text: I look at how nervously they are fidgeting with their hands or rubbing their palms.
I watch for 'micro-expressions'—tiny, split-second changes in their facial muscles.
I notice if their feet are pointed away from me or if their posture becomes unusually stiff.
I just 'feel' a shift in their energy; the atmosphere around them suddenly feels dense or blocked.

questions.scenario: If you were watching a movie completely on mute, what would you focus on to understand the story?

options.text: The close-up shots of the characters' hands holding objects, pointing, or touching.
The intense emotions shown strictly through the characters' eyes, eyebrows, and mouths.
The physical distance between characters and how they physically react to each other's presence.
The emotional tension in the scene—I can almost feel the mood radiating from the screen.

questions.scenario: You are visiting a museum and looking at portraits of historical kings and queens. What fascinates you?

options.text: Trying to zoom in on the paintings to see if the artist painted the lines on their palms.
Analyzing the shape of their noses and chins to guess what kind of rulers they actually were.
Studying their dominant stances and how they assert power through their painted posture.
Imagining the kind of heavy, royal energy or spiritual weight they carried in their time.

questions.scenario: If you could unlock a mystical superpower, which one would you choose?

options.text: The ability to touch someone's hand and instantly know their past struggles and future potential.
The ability to look at a stranger's face and instantly know their true personality and deepest traits.
The ability to perfectly predict what someone is going to do next just by watching their muscles twitch.
The ability to literally see people's emotions as bright, colorful halos glowing around them.

questions.scenario: A classmate is feeling very stressed before a big exam. How do you naturally comfort them?

options.text: I take their hand, trace the lines to distract them, and tell them they have a 'success line'.
I look them warmly in the eyes, read their expression, and say exactly what they need to hear.
I mirror their sitting position to build subconscious trust and help them physically relax their shoulders.
I tell them to take deep breaths while I try to project calm, positive energy into their space.

questions.scenario: What is a random topic you love researching or reading about in your free time?

options.text: How fingerprints are entirely unique and what the mounts of the hand signify.
Physiognomy, and how certain facial features are linked to specific psychological traits.
Psychology articles on how human beings unknowingly communicate 70% of their thoughts without speaking.
Chakras, spiritual frequencies, and how different colors represent different emotional states.

questions.scenario: When someone is lying to you, what is their biggest giveaway?

options.text: They hide their hands in their pockets or clench their fists.
Their smile doesn't reach their eyes, or their gaze shifts in a specific direction.
They touch their neck, cross their arms, or shuffle their feet uncomfortably.
Their words sound confident, but their internal frequency feels totally chaotic and dishonest.

questions.scenario: What kind of art or photography do you find most beautiful?

options.text: High-contrast, detailed black-and-white photos of elderly people's weathered, lined hands.
Extreme close-up portraits that capture the raw, emotional depth of a person's face.
Action shots of dancers or athletes where their body captures a perfect moment of expression.
Abstract art with vibrant, glowing colors that evoke a deep spiritual feeling.

questions.scenario: What kind of YouTube video are you most likely watching at 1 AM?

options.text: 'What a split Life Line actually means for your future.'
'How to read anyone's personality just by looking at their eyebrows.'
'FBI Agent analyzes the body language of famous celebrities lying in interviews.'
'Guided meditation to cleanse your energy and see your own aura in the mirror.'

Palmist.title: Palmist / Chirologist
Palmist.primary_match_text: You are fascinated by the map of human life. You believe that our past, present, and potential futures are physically etched into the lines of our hands.
Palmist.day_in_the_life: Meeting with clients, studying the shape, lines, and mounts of their hands, and offering them guidance on career, love, and life decisions based on ancient chiromancy techniques.
Palmist.alternative_match_text: If you enjoy looking at unique physical identifiers but want a strictly scientific route, studying fingerprint analysis in Forensic Science is a fascinating alternative.
Palmist.roadmap: While there is no formal academic degree for Palmistry, you can pursue a degree in Psychology or Counseling (3-4 years) while taking specialized certification courses in Chiromancy and Vedic Astrology.

Face_Reader.title: Face Reader / Physiognomist
Face_Reader.primary_match_text: You are a master of observation. You naturally understand people's core traits, strengths, and weaknesses just by analyzing the structure of their facial features.
Face_Reader.day_in_the_life: Consulting with individuals to help them understand their own personalities, analyzing micro-expressions to determine truthfulness, or even helping companies with character assessments.
Face_Reader.alternative_match_text: Because you are so good at reading facial cues, pursuing a career in Clinical Psychology, Behavioral Science, or even Acting/Directing could be highly rewarding.
Face_Reader.roadmap: Take Arts or Science in 11th/12th. Pursue a BA/B.Sc in Psychology, followed by specialized courses in Physiognomy, Micro-expressions (like Paul Ekman's training), or Behavioral Analysis.

Body_Language_Analyst.title: Body Language Analyst
Body_Language_Analyst.primary_match_text: You read between the lines. You know that words can lie, but the body never does. You are highly analytical and notice the physical movements everyone else ignores.
Body_Language_Analyst.day_in_the_life: Analyzing interview footage, working as a jury consultant to read people's reactions in court, or coaching politicians and CEOs on how to project confidence through their posture.
Body_Language_Analyst.alternative_match_text: With your sharp eye for human movement and deception, a career in Law Enforcement Profiling, Criminology, or Human Resources would be an excellent fit.
Body_Language_Analyst.roadmap: Take any stream in 11th/12th. Pursue a degree in Criminology, Psychology, or Communications, followed by specialized training in non-verbal communication and interrogation techniques.

Aura_Reader.title: Aura Reader / Energy Healer
Aura_Reader.primary_match_text: You are highly intuitive and deeply empathetic. You don't just see people; you feel them. You are naturally attuned to the energetic frequencies and emotional states of others.
Aura_Reader.day_in_the_life: Creating a calm, spiritual environment, identifying blockages in a client's energy field, and using techniques like Reiki or crystal healing to restore their emotional balance.
Aura_Reader.alternative_match_text: Since you are so focused on healing and empathy, alternative paths like Holistic Therapy, Art Therapy, or professional Counseling are deeply fulfilling backups.
Aura_Reader.roadmap: Focus on humanities or psychology. You can pursue alternative medicine degrees or take accredited courses in Reiki, Pranic Healing, and Aura Photography to build your practice.
